question: In this repository, answer four separate things, each under its own heading. (1) Which source files define rlmx's own custom LLM providers (not the ones the underlying LLM library ships), and for each: what base URL does it default to and which environment variable carries its API key? (2) How does the Python REPL subprocess receive code to execute and return its output — name the transport and every message type on it, from both the TypeScript side and the Python side. (3) What exactly decides whether the Gemini 'batteries' are loaded into the REPL namespace, and where are they loaded from? (4) How does a run decide that its context is too large for the model, and what does it switch on when that happens? Give a file:line citation for every claim.
toolDescription: Launch the "explore-r" rlmx agent to handle a task autonomously. Answers a question about the codebase in the server's working directory by partitioning it across recursive sub-agents, then verifying every citation itself. Returns the answer with resolvable file:line citations. Use it instead of grepping and reading a large tree inline. Runs on khal/deepseek-v4-flash. Give it a complete, standalone prompt — it runs to completion and returns a single final report, and cannot ask follow-up questions mid-run. The result carries the tokens and cost it used plus a session_id; pass that session_id back to this tool to continue the conversation. (rlmx microagent "explore-r", shape=recurse)
answer:
## (1) Custom LLM Providers

rlmx defines two custom LLM providers beyond the underlying pi/ai library's built-in ones:

**Station provider** (src/station-provider.ts) -- a local Lemonade gateway. Default base URL: http://localhost:13305/api/v1, set at lines 38-41 via `process.env.STATION_BASE_URL ?? process.env.LEMONADE_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:13305/api/v1"`. This provider is keyless.

**Khal provider** (src/khal-provider.ts) -- a LiteLLM gateway. Default base URL: https://llm.khal.ai/v1, set at line 47 via `process.env.KHAL_BASE_URL ?? "https://llm.khal.ai/v1"`. API key comes from KHAL_API_KEY (primary) or RLMX_KHAL_API_KEY (fallback), defined at line 74.

## (2) Python REPL IPC Transport

Transport: JSON lines over stdin/stdout (src/repl.ts:123-124, src/ipc.ts:1-2).

Node -> Python (src/ipc.ts:6-36): execute, llm_response, inject, reset, shutdown.

Python -> Node (src/ipc.ts:54-75, python/repl_server.py:16-19): execute_result, llm_request, ready.

## (3) Gemini Batteries Loading Decision

Gemini batteries load when both conditions are met (src/rlm.ts:414): `isGoogleProvider(config.model.provider) && (config.toolsLevel === "standard" || config.toolsLevel === "full")`.

Loaded from python/gemini_batteries.py (src/repl.ts:32) via _loadGeminiBatteries() at src/repl.ts:290-294.

## (4) Context Too Large Detection & Switch

validateContextSize() (src/cache.ts:52-67) estimates tokens as ceil((chars / 4) * 1.2) (line 37), then compares against PROVIDER_LIMITS[provider] (lines 15-20: anthropic=200000, openai=128000, google=1000000, default=128000).

When too large (src/cli.ts:382-397): disables cache mode (lines 388-389), enables storage mode when config.storage.enabled is 'auto' or 'always' (lines 392-393). Same logic for batch at lines 643-656.
